<function name="GetRangeSquaredTo" parent="NextBot" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns squared distance to an entity or a position.

See also <page>NextBot:GetRangeTo</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="to" type="Vector">The position to measure distance to. Can be an entity.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The squared distance</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
